name: Wedang Jahe
description: A warming Javanese ginger tea of bruised fresh ginger simmered with palm sugar and pandan leaves.
ingredients: a handful of fresh kaffir lime leaves, chopped
instructions: Combine the jasmine rice and chicken stock in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the coriander seeds and coconut cream, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 15 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with lime wedges, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
tips: Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
Make a big batch and keep it chilled in the fridge — the flavor often deepens after a few hours.
